verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈਸਤੁ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: traisat a(n)gul lai man pavan milaiaa|

en.bdb: The breath going ten fingers out the mind is associated with the vital air the practice is completed.
The imperceptible soham (I am He) is ualised in equipoise.
In this state of equipoise, the rare drink of ever-wing cascade is quaffed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਨਾਦ ਵਜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: anahadh dhun liv lai naadh vajaiaa|

en.bdb: Getting absorbed in the unstruck melody a mysterious sound is heard.
Through silent prayer, one merges in the Suny (Lord)
And in that perfect mental tranquillity egoism is done away with.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh piram chakhai nij ghar chhaiaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs drink from the cup of love and establish themselves in their own real self.
Meeting the Guru, the Sikh achieves the perfect completeness.
